principle: Free access demonstrates the philosophy; paid access buys deeper transparency, never a better verdict.

plans.description: Public verdicts, evidence summaries, major contradictions and unresolved items.
Expanded evidence summaries, provenance and market signal views.
Deeper provenance, evidence lineage, contradiction analysis and historical views.
Maximum permitted transparency, advanced evidence relationships, extended history and calibration views.

pricing_note: Pricing is intentionally low-friction and positioned below mainstream research subscriptions while preserving a free public layer. It can be recalibrated from observed conversion and retention data without changing truth calculations.
